prompt: Benny plants a garden behind the school
title: Benny Shares Tomatoes
irony: Benny plants a garden to keep the biggest tomato for himself, but it only grows when he shares it, so sharing feeds the school.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun warms the school fence where dark soil waits in a fresh low bed.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Benny pats tiny seeds in neat rows and picks the best spot for his biggest tomato.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox dares Benny that the seeds sleep deep and no green sprout ever pokes through.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Benny sings by the dirt as first green tips break through the warm soil.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Benny floods the bed with cold cans while Hattie trips chasing Knox down the path.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Mud flies as Benny slips in the puddle and seeds swim in muddy water.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Warm light dries the rows as brave leaves lift their heads high.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Vera studies the drowned bed and feels her careful plan crack in her chest.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Vera kneels beside Benny and shares dry seeds from her own pocket.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Benny hands fresh sprouts to Knox and pals as Vera claps by the fence.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Benny shares red tomatoes at the gate as Knox grins with dirt on his nose.
